guest: A private note would be lovely, about how he still makes me laugh after twenty years. No public singing or cake, please.
reply: “He still makes me laugh” is a wonderful sentiment for a private note, with no public singing or cake. For your unhurried exploring, would you enjoy wandering independently with a few suggestions, or having someone guide you for part of a day?

threads.detail: Twentieth wedding anniversary; nothing booked yet; want one special dinner. A private note about Tom still making Aisha laugh is welcome; no public singing or cake.
First Bangkok visit; want time to explore without packing every day. Exploring what kind of guidance would be welcome.
Loves Thai home cooking and fragrant Thai curries; has a severe peanut allergy.
Aisha reports that Tom has no food restrictions.
Happiest photographing gardens and little architectural details.
